scenes.title: Cécile Is Late
scenes.summary: Gabriel waits at a hotel photo shoot while Cécile de France rides a horse in the woods; she arrives late, and Gabriel gets the call that Tarantino won't cast her because of her age, but keeps it to himself. Opening titles included.
scenes.location: hotel suite photo shoot / riding school woods

scenes.title: I'll Have Lunch Twice
scenes.summary: The agency opens: Andréa juggles plays, lunches and her love life with her assistant Magali, and Mathias asks Gabriel why he isn't calling Cécile back.

scenes.title: I Just Want to See Mathias
scenes.summary: Camille arrives from the south and asks Sofia at reception to see Mathias Barneville without an appointment; Sofia thinks she's an actress.

scenes.title: Another Whim?
scenes.summary: Mathias greets Camille at the agency, then takes the conversation to a restaurant; she has moved to Paris and asks for help finding work in film, but he refuses.

scenes.title: Samuel's Last Meeting
scenes.summary: Samuel Kerr holds a last meeting before his first holiday in eight years; good news about Pierre Niney, then Gabriel admits Tarantino doesn't want Cécile, and Mathias blames him.

scenes.title: Magali Quits
scenes.summary: Andréa's exhausted assistant Magali says she is leaving; Andréa tries vitamins and bike rides, then fires her before she can quit.

scenes.title: Sofia says no to a promotion
scenes.summary: Andréa offers Sofia the assistant job; Sofia refuses because she is really an actress and invites Andréa to her play.

scenes.title: Andréa Hires Camille
scenes.summary: Andrea notices Camille waiting, brings her into her office, asks blunt questions about her background and availability, and hires her on the spot.

scenes.title: Samuel's advice, and goodbye
scenes.summary: Gabriel says he can't lie to Cécile; Samuel says just don't tell her the truth, then leaves for the airport and Rio.

scenes.title: Gabriel rejects Cécile's call
scenes.summary: Gabriel's phone rings with Cécile's name; he presses reject by mistake and the office laughs at him.

scenes.title: A Tour of the Agency
scenes.summary: Andréa explains the job and leaves Camille with Hervé and Noémie, who show her Accounts, Legal, the scripts, the press 'boutique', and gossip about Arlette and Andréa, until someone shouts that Cécile is here.

scenes.title: Do I Still Have an Agent?
scenes.summary: Cécile turns up at the agency and asks Hervé if she still has an agent, because Gabriel seems to be avoiding her; Gabriel slips away to lunch and hides behind a fake urgent phone call.

scenes.title: Too Old for the Part
scenes.summary: Camille meets Cécile alone, thinks she already knows, and tells her she was turned down for being too old.

scenes.title: I'm Fine Here
scenes.summary: Mathias is shocked to see Camille as Andréa's new assistant; he offers help elsewhere, she says she's fine here and he explodes: 'it's my life'.

scenes.title: Noémie's warning
scenes.summary: Noémie, who saw the argument, warns Camille that Mathias is very married.

scenes.title: I'm an Actress
scenes.summary: At a restaurant Sofia tells Gabriel she is really an actress and gives him the flyer for her play; he is distracted by his problem.

scenes.title: I'm Changing Agents
scenes.summary: Cécile finds Gabriel, who invents a story about the role becoming a man; she knows it was her age, calls him a liar and walks out to change agent.

scenes.title: An impossible task
scenes.summary: Andréa asks Camille to find out what Mathias was offered for Guillaume Canet. 'Improvise.'

scenes.title: The Contract and the Mole
scenes.summary: Camille asks Noémie to see Canet's contract and is refused; Gabriel storms in looking for the traitor who told Cécile; Mathias asks Noémie for Miranda Jones's number.

scenes.title: Miranda Says No
scenes.summary: Mathias flatters Tarantino's producer Miranda Jones; she says Cécile is 41 and too old, and it's decided.

scenes.title: Give Her Some Space
scenes.summary: Gabriel asks Andréa to talk to Cécile 'woman to woman'; Andréa is only 34 and tells him to give Cécile space until tomorrow.

scenes.title: A drink with Hervé
scenes.summary: In a bar Hervé tries to cheer Gabriel up by pointing at women; Gabriel isn't in the mood.

scenes.title: No Cécile, No Paris
scenes.summary: Miranda needs permits to shoot in Paris; Mathias says his friend at the ministry loves Cécile: no Cécile, no Paris.

scenes.title: Mathias in the Garden
scenes.summary: Mathias brings flowers to Cécile's garden; she says everyone lies, but he says Miranda is ready to talk again.

scenes.title: She said yes to him
scenes.summary: Gabriel tells Andréa that Cécile has signed with Mathias.

scenes.title: Your New Assistant
scenes.summary: Gabriel accuses Mathias of stealing Cécile; Mathias says he saved a client, then tells Andréa that her new assistant told Cécile she was too old.

scenes.title: Get Your Things
scenes.summary: Andréa fires Camille for talking to Cécile; Hervé is kind, Noémie barely says goodbye.

scenes.title: Just the Cheeks
scenes.summary: Mathias and Miranda tell Cécile that Quentin wants her, if she gets her cheeks done; Cécile refuses, then doesn't know anymore.

scenes.title: Arlette and Jean Gabin
scenes.summary: Leaving, Camille finds Arlette's dog Jean Gabin chewing a contract; she meets Arlette, the great impresario.

scenes.title: Cécile Says Yes
scenes.summary: Mathias shows Cécile a photo of his wife (51, lots of work done); Cécile agrees, and Mathias calls Miranda.

scenes.title: I'm Keeping You
scenes.summary: Camille leaves the figures for Andréa and goes; Andréa runs after her, reads them and keeps her.

scenes.title: Arlette Shakes Gabriel Up
scenes.summary: Gabriel lies in Arlette's office; Arlette mocks him and says Samuel forgot to teach him tenacity.

scenes.title: We Have to Talk
scenes.summary: Gabriel finds Cécile on a horse; they argue about who lied, while the horse runs off.

scenes.title: Will You Be My Agent?
scenes.summary: Cécile asks Gabriel to come to the clinic; he drives her, waits, and she comes back out: she won't do it, and asks him to be her agent again.

scenes.title: A Call from Rio
scenes.summary: At the agents' meeting Gabriel arrives pleased with himself: they lost a big contract but kept a great actress; then a call from the French consulate in Rio says Samuel has died after swallowing a wasp.
